visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three individuals sit on a light gray sofa in a brightly lit indoor room. A young woman in a pink t-shirt sits on the left, a woman in a black graphic t-shirt in the center, and a young man in a yellow striped shirt on the right. A small white plate containing various food items rests on a white table in the immediate foreground, directly in front of the group. (2) The trio engages in a rhythmic singing game, pointing at one another with extended fingers and clapping their hands in unison. Colorful text bubbles, icons, and status indicators like white circles and green checkmarks appear as overlays near their heads to denote performance accuracy. The background remains a consistent neutral-toned wall with a single electrical outlet visible. (3) The scene shifts to individual close-ups and quick cuts of the participants singing enthusiastically with wide smiles and animated facial expressions. A cartoon transition screen featuring stylized circular faces of the three people appears briefly before returning to the group setting. Later, the man holds up a vibrant yellow "Viva" brand snack bag featuring fruit and vegetable imagery. (4) Detailed close-up shots show the contents of the snack bag, including dried nuts and sliced vegetables like carrots and zucchini, being poured onto a decorated ceramic plate. Each individual is then shown in various domestic settings—sitting at a desk with a keyboard, lounging on the sofa, and standing—consuming the snacks with expressive, satisfied facial gestures. The video concludes with the group holding three bags of the product while giving thumbs up to the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy female voice speaking rapidly in a cheerful, conversational tone. Bright, mid-tempo acoustic pop music accompanies the speech, featuring prominent guitar strums and a steady electronic percussion beat that establishes a rhythmic and highly positive mood for the viewers. (2) A male voice enters, singing a familiar pop melody with a clear, resonant timbre and moderate intensity. Shortly after, the two female voices join in rhythmic harmony. The background music maintains its tempo and volume, providing a consistent bed for the coordinated vocal performances of the participants. (3) A distinct digital 'ding' sound effect, similar to a bell, signals a successful match in the singing game. This is followed by a brief, playful whoosh transition sound as the video cuts. The primary music track continues uninterrupted, featuring simple, clean harmonic progressions and a bright tonal balance. (4) A whimsical cartoon-style sound effect, characterized by a sliding pitch and elastic texture, occurs during a graphic transition. The vocals shift from singing to an energetic, rapid-fire pitch for a snack product. The BGM remains present but lowers slightly in relative volume to prioritize the clear promotional narration. (5) Audible sounds of a plastic bag rustling and the soft, percussive thud of contents being poured into a dish are detected. These short-duration incidental sounds are followed by high-frequency crunching noises, simulating a bite. The track concludes with a synchronized group slogan and a final musical crescendo.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the 'Viva' brand vegetable and nut snack mix by featuring popular content creators in a high-energy singing challenge format. The video transitions from social entertainment to a lifestyle-focused product showcase, emphasizing variety and flavor through eating demonstrations.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The characters explicitly name the brand '萬歲牌' (Viva), hold the product bag prominently to the camera, and describe its new features while eating it on screen.
